backend/main.mo: Motoko actor implementing a simple account system with user registration, PIN management, and balance tracking stored in a Principal-keyed map.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping implemented feature IDs (spacing, bank selection sheet, bank rows, etc.) to their source files, components, and test requirement IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing one-line summaries of every frontend source file, describing styling, functionality, and recent changes for build planning reference.
frontend/index.css: Base Tailwind CSS entry point defining light and dark CSS custom property tokens (background, foreground, primary, chart colors, sidebar) used throughout the app.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML shell titled 'GPay Prank Clone' that mounts the React app into a root div and loads the main TypeScript entry point.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root app component managing page-based navigation state, tab switching, payment flow, transaction selection, and conditional rendering of all pages with a bottom navigation bar.
frontend/src/components/BankLogos.tsx: Exports HdfcBankLogo and SbiBankLogo as inline SVG React components recreating HDFC's red-bracket/blue-center mark and SBI's blue circular torch emblem respectively.
frontend/src/components/BankRow.tsx: Reusable button row component displaying a bank logo on the left and a masked account number on the right, with selected/unselected dark-theme styling.
frontend/src/components/BankSelectionShe: A bottom sheet modal component that lets users select between HDFC and SBI bank accounts, with animated slide-up transition and Cancel/Continue action buttons.
frontend/src/components/BottomNavigation: A fixed bottom navigation bar with Home, Money, and You tabs, highlighting the active tab with icons and styled labels.
frontend/src/components/ContactCircles.t: Displays a horizontal row of contact avatar circles with names, triggering a callback when a contact is clicked.
frontend/src/components/PinEntryDialog.t: A bottom sheet PIN entry dialog with a 4-dot indicator, numeric keypad, shake animation on incorrect PIN, and optional PIN validation.
frontend/src/components/QuickActions.tsx: Renders a 3-column grid of quick-action buttons (e.g., Loan, Recharge, Shopping) with icons and labels, invoking a callback on click.
frontend/src/components/ScannerViewfinde: A fullscreen QR code scanner UI with an animated scanning line and mock detection logic that resolves to a random UPI ID after ~2.8 seconds.
frontend/src/context/PinContext.tsx: React context provider that persists and manages a payment PIN in localStorage, exposing set and validate helpers.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor using the current Internet Identity, invalidating dependent queries whenever the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and hook for Internet Identity authentication on the ICP platform, managing login/logout state, identity persistence, and AuthClient creation with configurable options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for interacting with the backend actor, including fetching balance, registering a user, updating balance, and updating a PIN.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that sets up Tailwind CSS, defines a dark-themed design token system using OKLCH color variables, and provides reusable component classes like gpay-card, gpay-btn, and pin-dot.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the React app wrapped with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider into the DOM root.
frontend/src/pages/BalancePage.tsx: A page that displays and allows editing of the user's wallet balance, gated behind a PIN entry dialog, with support for auto-registering new users on first balance update.
frontend/src/pages/ComingSoonPage.tsx: A placeholder page displayed for unimplemented features, showing a 'Coming Soon' message with the feature name and a back button.
frontend/src/pages/HistoryPage.tsx: Displays a combined transaction history list by merging locally stored payment entries with mock data, sorted by timestamp, with clickable rows for transaction details.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Main home screen displaying the GPay-style UI with a greeting, search bar, contact circles, quick actions, and navigation links to balance, history, and CIBIL score pages. Supports profile picture upload stored in localStorage.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentEntryPage.tsx: Form page for entering payment details (recipient name, phone, UPI ID, amount) that triggers a PIN dialog followed by a bank selection sheet before calling onSuccess with the payment details.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentSuccessPage.ts: Displays a payment confirmation screen with transaction details, plays a success tone, saves the entry to localStorage history, and offers a screenshot/done action.
frontend/src/pages/PinSetupPage.tsx: Two-step 4-digit PIN creation flow (create then confirm) that saves the PIN via PinContext and registers the user via a mutation hook upon successful confirmation.
frontend/src/pages/TransactionDetailPage: Detail view for a single transaction showing recipient avatar, contact info, transaction amount/timestamp, and a pay-again button, with deterministic helper functions for formatting and generating joined dates.
frontend/src/utils/contactData.ts: Defines the Contact interface and exports a static array of three sample contacts with name, phone, UPI ID, avatar path, initials, and color.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration for the frontend, extending the default theme with custom colors (GPay-style dark palette using oklch), fonts, border radii, shadows, and keyframe animations. Includes plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Tracks the current state of the GPay-style prank payment web app project, including a feature summary, architectural notes, known issues, and a detailed list of existing implemented features with their IDs and requirement references.
